jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist at Nestlé Research, your mission is to enable the proactive detection of potential food safety issues by strengthening the evaluation of external scientific signals and the evolution of digital early warning systems.. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with food safety, quality, research, technology, and external data partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist

• Strengthening proactive food safety early warning by scouting and evaluating emerging issues across priority contaminant areas.

• Identifying and assessing internal and external data sources that improve the detection, prioritization, and scientific evaluation of early signals.

• Contribute to the evaluation and deployment of digital technologies that enhance data-driven detection of emerging food safety topics.

• Testing prototypes that help transform early warning processes into scalable digital solutions.

• Participate in scientific collaborations that connect research, technology, and business needs to protect consumers.

• Delivering project activities with focus, rigor, and follow-through to support impactful food safety decisions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing basic chemistry knowledge and a good understanding of chemical contaminants, including how they can emerge, evolve, and impact food safety.

• Applying knowledge of food safety and quality processes in the context of supply chains, incident occurrence, issue evolution, and potential consumer impact.

• Using data and digital technologies in a food safety context, ideally to support data-driven risk assessment, root-cause analysis, and early warning decision-making.

• Collaborating effectively with diverse internal and external partners, while translating research into practical business impact.

• Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Come specialista associato di sicurezza alimentare digitale presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di consentire il rilevamento proattivo di potenziali problemi di sicurezza alimentare rafforzando la valutazione dei segnali scientifici esterni e l'evoluzione dei sistemi di allarme rapido digitale. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con la sicurezza alimentare, la qualità, la ricerca, la tecnologia e i partner di dati esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come specialista associato di sicurezza alimentare digitale

• Rafforzare la sicurezza alimentare proattiva in anticipo verificando e valutando i problemi emergenti in aree contaminanti prioritarie.

• Identificare e valutare fonti di dati interne ed esterne che migliorano il rilevamento, la priorità e la valutazione scientifica dei segnali iniziali.

• Contribuisci alla valutazione e alla distribuzione delle tecnologie digitali che migliorano il rilevamento dei dati degli argomenti di sicurezza alimentare emergenti.

• Testare i prototipi che aiutano a trasformare i processi di allarme precoce in soluzioni digitali scalabili.

• Partecipare a collaborazioni scientifiche che collegano la ricerca, la tecnologia e le esigenze aziendali per proteggere i consumatori.

• Fornire attività di progetto con focus, rigore e follow-through per supportare decisioni di sicurezza alimentare colpite.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare conoscenze di chimica di base e una buona comprensione dei contaminanti chimici, tra cui come possono emergere, evolvere e impatto sulla sicurezza alimentare.

• Applicare la conoscenza dei processi di sicurezza e qualità degli alimenti nel contesto delle catene di approvvigionamento, del verificarsi di incidenti, dell'evoluzione dei problemi e del potenziale impatto dei consumatori.

• Utilizzo dei dati e delle tecnologie digitali in un contesto di sicurezza alimentare, ideale per supportare la valutazione dei rischi, l'analisi delle cause della radice e il processo decisionale di avviso precoce.

• Collaborare efficacemente con diversi partner interni ed esterni, traducendo la ricerca nell'impatto pratico del business.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; la competenza lavorativa in francese è un plus.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que spécialiste associé de la sécurité alimentaire à Nestlé Research, votre mission est de permettre la détection proactive des problèmes potentiels de sécurité alimentaire en renforçant l'évaluation des signaux scientifiques externes et l'évolution des systèmes numériques d'alerte précoce. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les partenaires de la sécurité alimentaire, de la qualité, de la recherche, de la technologie et des données externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste associé de la sécurité alimentaire numérique

• Renforcer l'alerte précoce proactive en matière de salubrité des aliments en faisant le point et en évaluant les nouveaux enjeux dans les secteurs de contaminants prioritaires.

• Déterminer et évaluer les sources de données internes et externes qui améliorent la détection, l'établissement de priorités et l'évaluation scientifique des signaux précoces.

• Contribuer à l'évaluation et au déploiement de technologies numériques qui améliorent la détection par les données de nouveaux sujets liés à la salubrité des aliments.

• Tester des prototypes qui aident à transformer les processus d'alerte rapide en solutions numériques évolutives.

• Participer à des collaborations scientifiques qui relient la recherche, la technologie et les besoins des entreprises pour protéger les consommateurs.

• Mettre en oeuvre des activités de projet ciblées, rigoureuses et suivies pour appuyer les décisions relatives à la salubrité des aliments.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter des connaissances de base en chimie et une bonne compréhension des contaminants chimiques, y compris la façon dont ils peuvent émerger, évoluer et influer sur la salubrité des aliments.

• Appliquer la connaissance des processus de salubrité et de qualité des aliments dans le contexte des chaînes d'approvisionnement, des incidents, de l'évolution des enjeux et de l'impact potentiel des consommateurs.

• Utiliser les données et les technologies numériques dans un contexte de sécurité alimentaire, idéalement pour appuyer l'évaluation des risques fondée sur les données, l'analyse des causes profondes et la prise de décisions en matière d'alerte rapide.

• Collaborer efficacement avec divers partenaires internes et externes, tout en transformant la recherche en impact pratique.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; la maîtrise du français est un atout.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à #BreakthroughTogether ?

Appliquer maintenant et façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

jobs.title: Ingénieur-e Systèmes Logistiques
jobs.description:
Lieu : Avenches, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nestlé Nespresso Manufacturing SA
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant qu' Ingénieur-e Systèmes Logistiques , vous jouez un rôle essentiel au cœur des opérations du Centre de Production d'Avenches. Votre mission : garantir la performance et l'évolution des systèmes qui orchestrent chaque jour les flux logistiques permettant d'approvisionner nos clients dans le monde entier.

Au-delà de la technique, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes terrain, les experts centraux, les fournisseurs et les partenaires afin de transformer les défis opérationnels en solutions concrètes et durables.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant qu’Ingénieur-e Systèmes Logistiques ?

• Garantir la disponibilité, la stabilité et la performance des systèmes logistiques qui pilotent les flux automatisés du site et en garantir la visibilité par la création de reporting.

• Être le référent local des solutions WMS, WCS et des applications associées, tout en assurant leur évolution continue.

• Conduire ou contribuer aux projets stratégiques de modernisation, migration et transformation des systèmes logistiques.

• Partager les connaissances, documenter les solutions et contribuer au développement de l'expertise collective de l'équipe.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Formation supérieure en informatique industrielle, ingénierie des systèmes ou domaine équivalent.

• Expérience dans les domaines de la logistique, de la Supply Chain, du manufacturing ou des systèmes industriels.

• Bonne maîtrise des bases de données (mySQL, SSMS), des flux de données (ETL, ELT) et des plateformes d'intégration (IBM AppConnect).

• Capacité à analyser des situations complexes, prendre des initiatives et piloter les actions jusqu'à leur résolution.

• Excellentes compétences relationnelles et aptitude à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie

• Politique parentalité avantageuse

• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés

• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques

• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Coffee Specialist - Nespresso
jobs.description:
Standort : Zürich
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort / Teilzeit, 70%
Vertragsart: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

Als Coffee Specialist bei Nespresso begeistern Sie unsere Kund:innen mit Ihrer Leidenschaft für Service und Kaffee. Als erste Ansprechperson in der Boutique erkennen Sie ihre Bedürfnisse und schaffen durch persönliche Beratung ein erstklassiges Markenerlebnis. Das ist Ihre Chance, die Welt des Kaffees mitzugestalten und echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.

So werden Sie als Coffee Specialist einen Unterschied machen

• Sicherstellen eines herzlichen Empfangs und eines angenehmen Erlebnisses für unsere Gäste sowie individuelle Beratung unserer Kundschaft, Durchführung von Kaffeedegustationen und aktiver Verkauf unserer Produkte

• Eigenständige Behebung einfacher Maschinenstörungen sowie Koordination von Reparaturen

• Unterstützung und Beratung des Teams bei technischen Fragestellungen rund um unsere Kaffeemaschinen

• Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung von Ersatzteilen sowie der Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanliegen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Servicepartnern

• Erfassung von Bestellungen, Durchführung der Kassenabrechnung sowie sorgfältige Pflege und laufende Aktualisierung der Kundendatei

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Erreichung individueller sowie Boutique-Ziele und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses in der Boutique

Was Sie erfolgreich macht

• Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Retail oder in der Gastronomie

• Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Leidenschaft für Kaffee, Marke und einzigartige Kundenerlebnisse

• Interesse und Freude daran, technische Fragestellungen rund um Kaffeemaschinen zu lösen sowie Ihr Wissen mit Kolleg:innen zu teilen

• Erfahrung in der Schulung, Unterstützung oder fachlichen Begleitung von Kolleg:innen ist von Vorteil

• Flexible, gut organisierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch sind ein Plus

• Sie leben unsere WECAN Verhaltensweisen: We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we Innovate

Was Sie bei Nespresso erwartet

Wir wachsen gemeinsam – in einer Kultur der Wertschätzung, Inklusion und Innovation. Unsere Benefits unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung und Ihr Wohlbefinden:

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf eine Vielzahl von Produkten und Dienstleistungen des täglichen Bedarf

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über den gesetzlichen Anspruch hinaus

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub sowie umfassende Unterstützungsangebote für Familien

• Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktiver Arbeitgeberbeitrag zur Pensionskasse

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Förderung Ihrer beruflichen Weiterentwicklung

Was Sie in unserem Bewerbungsprozess erwartet

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützung zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig barrierefrei und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Einrichtungen und Prozessen, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich sowie ein abschließendes Gespräch mit Angebot. Wir prüfen eingehende Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schließen die Stelle, sobald wir eine überzeugende Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen identifiziert haben – daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie aufmerksam: Nestlé nimmt mit Bewerber:innen ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens Kontakt auf und wird Sie zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Bewerbungsprozess um Zahlungen oder die Angabe sensibler persönlicher Informationen bitten.

Bereit, gemeinsam zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie neu, was Sie werden können.

In welcher Funktion auch immer – Sie können echte Veränderungen bewirken und andere für Ihre Ideen begeistern. Bei Nespresso werden Sie aufblühen und sich zugehörig fühlen. Wir inspirieren Sie, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und Ihr Bestes zu geben.

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: Office-based / a tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Contratto a termine fisso (2 anni)

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Ingegnere Bioprocess - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di condurre attività di bioprocessing che colmano la scoperta su scala di laboratorio e la produzione industriale attraverso soluzioni di fermentazione robuste e di lavorazione a valle. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di impianti pilota, scienziati, ingegneri, specialisti della qualità e della sicurezza, esperti tecnici e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come ingegnere del bioprocesso - impianto pilota (DSP)

• Prove di bioprocesso pilota che aiutano a trasformare la ricerca promettente in soluzioni di produzione scalabili.

• Sviluppo del processo di fermentazione di guida ottimizzando i media, le strategie di alimentazione e i parametri di funzionamento chiave per prestazioni affidabili.

• Sviluppare approcci di elaborazione a valle che migliorano la resa, il recupero e la qualità del prodotto.

• Costruire la comprensione del processo attraverso analisi dei dati, intuizioni di automazione e strumenti digitali che supportano l'ottimizzazione e la riproducibilità.

• Contribuire a operazioni pilota sicure, conformi e di alta qualità attraverso la valutazione del rischio, la documentazione e il miglioramento continuo.

• Definire lo sviluppo di nuove capacità di impianto pilota biotecnologico, traducendo le esigenze di processo in attrezzature pratiche e soluzioni di impianti.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza nelle operazioni di fermentazione, bioprocessing e pilota o su scala industriale.

• Applicando conoscenze di scala, trasferimento tecnologico e industrializzazione per rendere i processi robusti e pronti per l'implementazione.

• Utilizzando strumenti di pensiero analitico, elaborare dati e automazione per risolvere i problemi, ottimizzare e migliorare la riproducibilità.

• Collaborare tra team di ricerca, ingegneria, operazioni, qualità e sicurezza con la proprietà e una mentalità pratica.

• Comunicare con fiducia e fornire presentazioni in francese o in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, Bioprozessing-Aktivitäten zu leiten, die die Entdeckung im Labormaßstab und die industrielle Fertigung durch robuste Fermentations- und Downstream-Verarbeitungslösungen verbinden. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Pilotanlagenteams, Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsspezialisten, technischen Experten und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP) etwas bewirken

• Führende Bioprozessversuche im Pilotmaßstab, die dazu beitragen, vielversprechende Forschung in skalierbare Fertigungslösungen umzuwandeln.

• Förderung der Entwicklung von Fermentationsprozessen durch Optimierung von Medien, Fütterungsstrategien und wichtigen Betriebsparametern für eine zuverlässige Leistung.

• Entwicklung nachgelagerter Verarbeitungsansätze, die den Ertrag, die Rückgewinnung und die Produktqualität verbessern.

• Aufbau eines Prozessverständnisses durch Datenanalyse, Automatisierungseinsichten und digitale Tools, die die Optimierung und Reproduzierbarkeit unterstützen.

• Beitrag zu einem sicheren, konformen und qualitativ hochwertigen Pilotbetrieb durch Risikobewertung, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

• Gestaltung der Entwicklung neuer Biotech-Pilotanlagen durch Umsetzung der Prozessanforderungen in praktische Ausrüstungs- und Anlagenlösungen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen starker Expertise in den Bereichen Fermentation, Bioverarbeitung und Pilot- oder Industriebetrieb.

• Anwendung von Scale-up, Technologietransfer und Industrialisierungswissen, um Prozesse robust und bereit für die Implementierung zu machen.

• Mit analytischem Denken, Prozessdaten und Automatisierungstools zur Fehlersuche, Optimierung und Verbesserung der Reproduzierbarkeit.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Forschungs-, Ingenieur-, Betriebs-, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsteams mit Eigenverantwortung und einer praktischen Denkweise.

• Vertrauensvoll kommunizieren und Präsentationen in Französisch oder Englisch halten.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant qu'ingénieur en bioprocédés - usine pilote (Fermentation & DSP) chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de diriger des activités de bioprocédés qui permettent la découverte à l'échelle du laboratoire et la fabrication industrielle grâce à des solutions de fermentation robustes et de traitement en aval. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes d'usines pilotes, les scientifiques, les ingénieurs, les spécialistes de la qualité et de la sécurité, les experts techniques et les partenaires externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant qu'ingénieur de bioprocédés - usine pilote (DSP)

• Diriger des essais pilotes de bioprocédés qui aident à transformer des recherches prometteuses en solutions de fabrication évolutives.

• Conduire le développement du processus de fermentation en optimisant les milieux, les stratégies d'alimentation et les paramètres d'exploitation clés pour une performance fiable.

• Élaborer des méthodes de transformation en aval qui améliorent le rendement, la récupération et la qualité des produits.

• Développer la compréhension des processus par l'analyse des données, l'automatisation et les outils numériques qui soutiennent l'optimisation et la reproductibilité.

• Contribuer à l'exploitation d'installations pilotes sûres, conformes et de haute qualité par l'évaluation des risques, la documentation et l'amélioration continue.

• Façonner le développement de nouvelles capacités d'usines pilotes de biotechnologie en traduisant les besoins en processus en équipements pratiques et en solutions d'installations.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans la fermentation, le biotraitement et les opérations pilotes ou industrielles.

• Appliquer l'échelle, le transfert de technologie et les connaissances en matière d'industrialisation pour rendre les processus robustes et prêts à être mis en œuvre.

• Utiliser la pensée analytique, les données de processus et les outils d'automatisation pour dépanner, optimiser et améliorer la reproductibilité.

• Collaborer à l'ensemble des équipes de recherche, d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de qualité et de sécurité avec la propriété et un état d'esprit pratique.

• Communiquer avec confiance et présenter des exposés en français ou en anglais.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On site
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Target start date: December 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

As an R&D Chefs Culinarium Intern at Nestlé Research, you will help bring the future of food to life. Working alongside chefs, scientists and global cross-category teams, you will contribute to the creation of innovative food concepts and tasting experiences that support strategic innovation projects. From recipe conceptualization and culinary prototyping to high-impact tastings and events, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of culinary excellence and food innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Chefs Culinarium Intern

• Supporting the Culinary Flagship team in delivering memorable strategic tastings, leadership events and product showcases that bring innovation to life.

• Creating and refining culinary prototypes, transforming early concepts into engaging tasting experiences and project recommendations.

• Collaborating with chefs, scientists and cross-functional teams to explore new ideas and contribute to innovation projects.

• Capturing prototypes, recipes and project learnings in operational catalogues and databases to ensure knowledge sharing and continuity.

• Exploring global food cultures, cooking techniques and consumer eating habits to build a deeper understanding of cuisines and culinary trends.

What will make you successful

• Currently pursuing a degree in Culinary Arts, with initial practical kitchen experience and a passion for food, recipe conceptualization, culinary storytelling, and creating memorable food experiences through high-impact presentations, plating, tasting experiences, and prototype creation.

• Curious and enthusiastic about learning how culinary creativity and science come together to develop innovative food products and concepts, with a proactive, self-driven mindset

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• Demonstrates adaptability, agility, resilience and a continuous learning mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

jobs.title: Machine Quality Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process
We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Work model: Hybrid / Full time

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Technician in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide analytical support in lipids analytics and deliver timely, high-quality data that supports research, innovation, and operational needs. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, peers across analytical groups, and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Technician in Lipids Analytics

• Delivering timely, high-quality lipid data that advances research projects and supports operational priorities.

• Implementing analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities.

• Advancing innovation by exploring and applying new analytical technologies that expand what is possible in lipids analytics.

jobs.title: R&D Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Start date: February 2027, flexible
Activity rate: 100%

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Data Science Intern, you will contribute to innovative projects across various Nestlé research and development facilities. Collaborating with Nestlé experts, you will help design the research tools of the future, contributing to advancements in data science and technology. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Data Science Intern

• Developing digital tools that enable researchers and product developers to work more effectively.

• Building computer vision models that characterize products and extract valuable information.

• Creating reliable data pipelines that turn experimental data into usable insights.

• Delivering automated reports and clear dashboards that support evidence-based decisions.

• Documenting reusable code and sharing your solutions with colleagues across research and development teams.

What will make you successful

• Current student or fresh graduate in Data Science, Computer Science or a related field

• Bringing strong programming skills in Python or R and the ability to build clear, maintainable solution

• Applying knowledge of data science, machine learning, computer vision and cloud-based application development.

• Being proactive, resourceful and curious, with the autonomy to solve problems and the openness to collaborate.

• Fluency in English, French would be an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Activity rate: 100%
Deadline for applications: 19 October, 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern – Powder Structure and Performance, you will join a six-month project focused on the materials science of multicomponent powders. You will help the team investigate how compositional factors, including lipid and protein content, affect powder structure, dissolution and flowability, combining experimental characterization with quantitative data analysis to develop scientifically grounded composition–property relationships. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern – Powder Structure and Performance

• Review literature on multicomponent powders, interfacial phenomena and composition - structure - property relationships.

• Define testable hypotheses linking lipid and protein composition to powder behaviour.

• Design and conduct controlled experiments using relevant compositional, physicochemical and functional measurements.

• Characterize powder dissolution and flowability using reproducible quantitative methods.

• Apply statistical and graphical analysis to identify correlations, trends and governing parameters.

• Interpret the results mechanistically and communicate conclusions through a technical report and presentation.

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Materials Science, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Chemistry or a related scientific field.

• Good understanding of powder behaviour, transport phenomena, interfacial science or physical and chemical characterization.

• Being curious, rigorous and hands-on, with enthusiasm for laboratory work, experimental design and developing new approaches to scientific questions.

• Having strong quantitative analysis and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with varied technical partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French is an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an Innovation Insight Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee, your mission will be to uncover emerging consumer needs, cultural shifts and marketplace signals, and translate them into meaningful opportunities for the future of coffee.

Working within the Front-End Innovation team, you will contribute to strategic projects across global coffee brands, including Nescafé, Starbucks, Nespresso, Nescafé Dolce Gusto. You will collaborate with innovation, consumer insights, design and R&D experts, gaining hands-on experience at the intersection of consumer understanding, foresight and innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an Innovation Insight Intern

• Conduct trend scouting, foresight and social listening activities to identify emerging consumer behaviours, cultural shifts and future opportunities

• Map marketplace developments, brands and sources of inspiration to support innovation projects

• Contribute to qualitative and quantitative consumer research, data analysis and insight generation

• Help transform research findings into innovation territories, opportunity spaces and consumer-led concepts

• Create clear presentations, recommendations and compelling stories from complex information

• Support the preparation and facilitation of workshops with internal teams and external partners

• Support the AI-transformation journey of the team

• Explore and embed AI-powered approaches to accelerate innovation development and team workflows

What will make you successful

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Consumer Insights, Psychology, Sociology, Marketing, Business, Innovation, Statistics or a related field

• Initial experience or strong interest in consumer research, including qualitative or quantitative methods, trend analysis, strategy or innovation

• Ability to analyse and synthesize complex information and transform it into clear insights, recommendations and opportunity areas

• Confidence using PowerPoint and Canva, together with curiosity for generative AI tools. Familiarity with Excel and Mural is an advantage

• Strong written, visual and verbal storytelling skills, with fluency in English

• You demonstrate courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning while translating ideas into meaningful impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture.

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

In qualità di Innovation Insight Intern al Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee, la vostra missione sarà scoprire le esigenze emergenti dei consumatori, i cambiamenti culturali e i segnali di mercato, e tradurli in opportunità significative per il futuro del caffè.

Lavorando all'interno del team Front-End Innovation, contribuirai a progetti strategici tra i marchi di caffè globali, tra cui Nescafé, Starbucks, Nespresso, Nescafé Dolce Gusto. Collaborerai con l'innovazione, le intuizioni dei consumatori, il design e gli esperti R&D, acquisendo esperienza pratica nell'intersezione della comprensione dei consumatori, della previsione e dell'innovazione.

Come farete un impatto come un Interno per l’Innovazione

• Condurre attività di scouting, di previsione e di ascolto sociale per identificare comportamenti emergenti dei consumatori, cambiamenti culturali e opportunità future

• Mappa sviluppi del mercato, brand e fonti di ispirazione per sostenere i progetti di innovazione

• Contribuire alla ricerca qualitativa e quantitativa dei consumatori, all'analisi dei dati e alla generazione di informazioni

• Aiuta a trasformare i risultati della ricerca in territori di innovazione, spazi opportunità e concetti orientati al consumatore

• Creare presentazioni chiare, raccomandazioni e storie convincenti da informazioni complesse

• Sostenere la preparazione e la facilitazione di workshop con team interni e partner esterni

• Sostenere il viaggio AI-trasformazione del team

• Esplora e incorpora gli approcci basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per accelerare lo sviluppo dell'innovazione e i flussi di lavoro del team

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Attualmente perseguire o recentemente completato una laurea o Master in Insights di consumo, Psicologia, Sociologia, Marketing, Business, Innovazione, Statistica o un campo correlato

• Esperienza iniziale o forte interesse per la ricerca dei consumatori, tra cui metodi qualitativi o quantitativi, analisi delle tendenze, strategia o innovazione

• Capacità di analizzare e sintetizzare informazioni complesse e trasformarle in chiari approfondimenti, raccomandazioni e aree di opportunità

• Confidenza utilizzando PowerPoint e Canva, insieme alla curiosità per gli strumenti AI generativi. La familiarità con Excel e Mural è un vantaggio

• Forte capacità di narrazione scritta, visiva e verbale, con fluenza in inglese

• Dimostrate coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto significativo e creando valore condiviso

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e possiamo chiudere il ruolo una volta che è stata identificata una forte selezione di candidati pertinenti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni saranno trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo attraverso gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non richiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili durante il processo di reclutamento.

Pronto a iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches

Als Innovation Insight Praktikant im Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee besteht Ihre Mission darin, aufkommende Verbraucherbedürfnisse, kulturelle Veränderungen und Marktsignale aufzudecken und sie in sinnvolle Chancen für die Zukunft des Kaffees umzusetzen.

In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team von Front-End Innovation tragen Sie zu strategischen Projekten globaler Kaffeemarken bei, darunter Nescafé, Starbucks, Nespresso und Nescafé Dolce Gusto. Sie werden mit Innovation, Consumer Insights, Design- und F & E-Experten zusammenarbeiten und praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Verbraucherverständnis, Vorausschau und Innovation sammeln.

Wie Sie als Innovation Insight Intern etwas bewirken

• Durchführung von Trendscouting, Foresight und Social Listening-Aktivitäten, um aufkommende Verbraucherverhalten, kulturelle Veränderungen und zukünftige Chancen zu identifizieren

• Karte Marktentwicklungen, Marken und Inspirationsquellen zur Unterstützung von Innovationsprojekten

• Beitrag zur qualitativen und quantitativen Verbraucherforschung, Datenanalyse und Gewinnung von Erkenntnissen

• Helfen Sie, Forschungsergebnisse in Innovationsgebiete, Chancenräume und verbrauchergeführte Konzepte umzuwandeln

• Erstellen Sie klare Präsentationen, Empfehlungen und überzeugende Geschichten aus komplexen Informationen

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops mit internen Teams und externen Partnern

• Unterstützen Sie die KI-Transformationsreise des Teams

• Erkunden und Einbetten von KI-gestützten Ansätzen zur Beschleunigung von Innovationsentwicklung und Teamworkflows

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Derzeit verfolgt oder kürzlich einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Consumer Insights, Psychologie, Soziologie, Marketing, Business, Innovation, Statistik oder einem verwandten Bereich abgeschlossen

• Erste Erfahrungen oder starkes Interesse an Verbraucherforschung, einschließlich qualitativer oder quantitativer Methoden, Trendanalyse, Strategie oder Innovation

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen zu analysieren und zu synthetisieren und in klare Einsichten, Empfehlungen und Chancenbereiche umzuwandeln

• Vertrauen mit PowerPoint und Canva, zusammen mit Neugier auf generative KI-Tools. Vertrautheit mit Excel und Mural ist von Vorteil

• Starke schriftliche, visuelle und verbale Storytelling-Fähigkeiten, mit fließendem Englisch

• Sie zeigen Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in sinnvolle Auswirkungen umsetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Bei Nestlé stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind voll zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur unterstützt.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle möglicherweise ab, sobald eine starke Auswahl relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und niemals Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen während des Einstellungsprozesses anfordern.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Orbe, Suisse
Type de contrat / durée: Stage, 6 mois
Date de début : janvier 2027 ou plus tard

Date limite de dépôt des candidatures: 26 octobre 2026

Soyez une force pour le bien et transformez votre potentiel en quelque chose d'extraordinaire

En tant que stagiaire en innovation à Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee, votre mission sera de découvrir les besoins émergents des consommateurs, les changements culturels et les signaux du marché, et de les traduire en opportunités significatives pour l'avenir du café.

En travaillant au sein de l'équipe de Front-End Innovation, vous contribuerez à des projets stratégiques dans les marques mondiales de café, notamment Nescafé, Starbucks, Nespresso, Nescafé Dolce Gusto. Vous collaborerez avec des experts en innovation, en conception et en R-D, en acquérant une expérience pratique à l'intersection de la compréhension des consommateurs, de la prévoyance et de l'innovation.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que stagiaire Innovation Insight

• Mener des activités de dépistage des tendances, de prévision et d'écoute sociale afin d'identifier les comportements émergents des consommateurs, les changements culturels et les possibilités futures

• Carte des développements du marché, des marques et des sources d'inspiration pour soutenir des projets d'innovation

• Contribuer à la recherche qualitative et quantitative sur les consommateurs, à l'analyse des données et à la production de renseignements

• Aider à transformer les résultats de la recherche en territoires d'innovation, en espaces d'opportunité et en concepts dirigés par les consommateurs

• Créer des présentations claires, des recommandations et des histoires convaincantes à partir d'informations complexes

• Appuyer la préparation et la facilitation d'ateliers avec des équipes internes et des partenaires extérieurs

• Soutenir le voyage AI-transformation de l'équipe

• Explorer et intégrer des approches alimentées par l'IA pour accélérer le développement de l'innovation et les flux de travail d'équipe

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Poursuivant ou ayant récemment terminé un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en consommation, psychologie, sociologie, marketing, affaires, innovation, statistiques ou un domaine connexe

• Expérience initiale ou grand intérêt pour la recherche sur les consommateurs, y compris les méthodes qualitatives ou quantitatives, l'analyse des tendances, la stratégie ou l'innovation

• Capacité d'analyser et de synthétiser des informations complexes et de les transformer en idées claires, recommandations et domaines d'opportunité

• Confiance à l'aide de PowerPoint et de Canva, ainsi que la curiosité pour les outils génériques d'IA. Familiarité avec Excel et Mural est un avantage

• Fortes compétences en narration écrite, visuelle et verbale, avec maîtrise de l'anglais

• Vous montrez du courage, de la collaboration, de la rapidité et de l'apprentissage continu tout en traduisant des idées en impact significatif et en créant une valeur partagée

Chez Nestlé, on place les gens au cœur de tout ce qu'on fait

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et appuyés par une solide culture de sécurité.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous étudions les candidatures reçues et pouvons fermer le rôle une fois qu'une forte sélection de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations seront traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé ne communiquera avec les candidats qu'au moyen d'adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles pendant le processus de recrutement.

Prêt à commencer votre parcours professionnel avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et transformer votre potentiel en quelque chose d'extraordinaire.

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Manufacturing, vous participerez à la promotion de l'adoption de solutions numériques pour optimiser les opérations de l'usine grâce à la mise en œuvre de nouvelles solutions telles que TrendMiner, Braincube et des outils d'intelligence artificielle.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Manufacturing ?

• Définir et appliquer la méthodologie appropriée pour gérer un projet de solutions basées sur les données numériques
• Participer à l’amélioration continue
• Dispenser des formations et du coaching sur les outils digitaux pour accélérer la montée en compétence des Opérateurs et Techniciens.
• Assurer une présence quotidienne sur le terrain pour soutenir la montée en compétence et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration.
• S’assurer de la bonne application de nos règles de sécurité, qualité, hygiène et environnement
• Contribuer à un travail de groupe efficace
• Communiquer de façon transparente et précise.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Elève-Ingénieur-e en dernière année de formation
• Expérience terrain dans un département engineering ou production, un atout
• Connaissance en science des données
• Des compétences en programmation en Python et R atout majeur.
• Expérience en gestion de projet, un atout
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey - Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager within our global M&A team, you will play a key role in shaping and executing strategic corporate projects that support the long-term growth of the Nestlé Group. Leading acquisitions, divestments, joint-ventures and other high-impact initiatives, you will ensure strong governance, rigorous valuation, and effective negotiations that create value and manage risk. Working closely with Zone and SBU leadership, Market Heads and CFOs, senior management, and specialist internal and external partners, you will help turn strategic opportunities into measurable business impact on a global scale, working across categories and geographies.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner with Zones and Strategic Business Units to shape M&A strategies and evaluate potential acquisition or divestment opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end acquisition and divestment processes, ensuring projects follow the appropriate governance and approval requirements.

• Assess financial, strategic, and operational risks and opportunities to strengthen decision-making and negotiation positions.

• Lead negotiations on transaction agreements to optimize value and manage risk for Nestlé.

• Provide timely, clear, and decision-relevant information to senior management throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate internal specialists and manage relationships with investment banks, financial advisers, accounting advisers, legal counsel, and other external partners to ensure the timely completion of projects.

What will make you successful

• Extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions or in leading complex projects within a multinational organization, consultancy, investment bank, or financial advisory environment.

• Strong expertise in financial management, business analysis, valuation, governance, risk management, and strategic business planning.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, businesses, and geographies.

• Fluency in English, with additional languages considered an advantage, combined with flexibility, sound judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, interviews with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role on the date listed above, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Digital and Automation Engineering Specialist (DMO/MES) at Nestlé Nutrition & Health, your mission is to identify, develop and scale digital manufacturing and automation solutions that strengthen performance across the Nutrition & Health manufacturing network. At our R&D center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé Nutrition & Health factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory, engineering, quality, operations, research and development, digital and automation teams, technology partners and strategic suppliers. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Digital and Automation Engineering Specialist (DMO/ MES)

• Leading the development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories.

• Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of manufacturing execution systems, operational technology and automation solutions across Nutrition and Health sites.

• Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging digital technologies into scalable business value.

• Delivering expert guidance for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations.

• Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation.

• Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in digital technologies applied to manufacturing, automation, industrial software and operational technology, supported by a Master’s degree in Engineering with a background in digital technologies.

• Applying strong experience in digital manufacturing solutions, AI and robotics, manufacturing execution systems (DMO/MES), automation and digital engineering within manufacturing or food industry environments.

• Using solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools to strengthen operational performance.

• Collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within dairy processes.

• Communicating with full professional proficiency in English and bringing the willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

• Using solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools to strengthen operational performance.

• Collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within dairy processes.

• Communicating with full professional proficiency in English and bringing the willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.
