titleByLocale.fr: Corporate Insurance Spécialiste - Non-Life & Insured Benefits

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits at Nestlé, your mission is to support the effective renewal and administration of global insurance programs that protect our people, operations and assets. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Risk Services colleagues, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, markets, insurance brokers and insurers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits

• Supporting timely, accurate renewals of global non-life and insured employee benefits programs.

• Coordinating insurance data, submissions and documentation to strengthen coverage decisions across markets.

• Ensuring policies, endorsements, premium allocations and payments are accurate and completed on time.

• Managing smaller insurance programs from renewal administration through payment and claims follow-up.

• Contributing to fair, effective selection processes for global and local insurers and brokers.

• Building trusted relationships that improve service quality and support consistent insurance delivery worldwide.

What will make you successful

• Bringing practical knowledge of insurance gained with an insurer, broker or corporate risk management team.

• Applying strong attention to detail across renewals, data collection, policy reviews, premium allocation and record keeping.

• Using sound knowledge of non-life insurance and insured employee benefits to support global programs confidently.

• Collaborating effectively across teams while building productive relationships with insurers, brokers and internal partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French and German are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen , Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Manufacturing Specialist, your mission is to lead manufacturing support for innovation and renovation projects, providing technical and operational expertise that enables successful industrialization and sustainable factory performance. At our research and development center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, businesses, markets, factories, suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leading manufacturing support across innovation and renovation projects to turn promising concepts into competitive products, processes and systems

• Driving early manufacturing input, risk assessment and technical decisions that improve readiness, speed and implementation quality

• Delivering reliable technical assistance during industrialization, start-ups and product launches to achieve efficient, sustainable factory performance

• Building and documenting specialist knowledge, standards and guidelines that strengthen manufacturing capability across sites

• Exploring breakthrough technologies and processes that create new opportunities for innovation, productivity and competitive advantage

• Developing factory knowledge through training, coaching and networks that accelerate learning and cross-site collaboration

What will make you successful

• Bringing deep manufacturing, engineering or product development expertise to industrialization and factory support

• Applying current quality, safety and hygiene standards to deliver robust and sustainable solutions

• Using data analysis, digital tools and structured problem solving to identify risks and improve performance

• Collaborating across functions, sites and cultures while communicating technical recommendations clearly to varied audiences

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Machines at Nestlé Global Procurement, your mission is to lead and implement the global sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, delivering value through innovation, competitiveness, sustainability, and risk management. You are responsible for end-to-end spend management, supplier selection, negotiations and managing relationships with coffee machine manufacturers to ensure a reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective supply chain aligned with Nestlé’s Procurement Standards. We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager – Machines

• Define and implement the sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, aligned with the Global Beverage Machine category while contributing to its development.

• Lead sourcing activities for supplier selection, leveraging negotiations, eRFX solutions, and by executing best‑in‑class Manufacturing and Supply Agreements.

• Build and lead the efficiency roadmap by driving cost‑reduction initiatives such as component standardization through platform approaches, best‑cost‑country sourcing and the use of alternative materials.

• Strengthen sourcing flexibility and supply risk mitigation across the full value chain, from Machine assembly to components and their raw materials.

• Build strong relationships with Nespresso Procurement business partners to unlock full category‑management value.

• Lead supplier development and compliance, including performance assessment and supplier profiling with clear targets and development plans.

• Develop and analyze TDC (Total Delivered Cost), monitor commodity trends and manage budget variations through proactive price anticipation and productivity impact.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience and proven proficiency in procurement within above‑market or large‑market structures, ideally in Contract Manufacturing procurement or technical categories.

• Dual competence supported by a degree in mechanical or electronic engineering (preferred).

• Advanced negotiation capabilities, with proven experience in eRFX and high‑value contract management.

• Strong analytical skills and Total Delivered Cost mindset, with the ability to manage multiple sub‑categories simultaneously (electronics, electro‑mechanical, plastic injection, CAPEX).

• Excellent communication abilities, enabling clear presentation of opportunities, results, and actionable recommendations.

• Fluent written and spoken English, any additional language considered as a strong plus.

jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Contract type / duration: Internship, 6 months
Start date: January/February 2026
Deadline for Application:

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Product Development Intern at Nestlé, your mission is to support the Powder Creamer Team in developing new solutions that optimize powder properties and manufacturing processes. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with Product Development Specialists, project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Product Development Intern

• Support R&D product development projects and design experiments to identify powder creamer solutions with defined functional and sensory properties.

• Plan, prepare and conduct kitchen, benchtop, prototyping and pilot plant trials, including the preparation of prototypes for validation.

• Coordinate raw materials, product analytics, sample releases, sensory evaluations and keeping-quality tests.

• Assess the sustainability impact of developed solutions in collaboration with the project manager.

• Document, report and present project results while building effective collaboration with project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in progress or completed in Science and Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related field, with exposure to materials science, chemistry or physics.

• Strong interest in innovation and a problem-solving mindset, supported by hands-on curiosity and a willingness to learn.

• Good communication and networking skills, with experience collaborating in multidisciplinary teams and building relationships based on trust.

• Fluency in English. German is a strong asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

jobs.title: Global Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing substantial medical marketing experience in nutrition, pharmaceuticals or consumer healthcare environments.

• Applying scientific and regulatory awareness, including familiarity with external guidelines and regulations relevant to healthcare professional and advocacy relations to develop credible branded and non-branded healthcare professional programmes and materials.

• Using strategic planning, data analysis and project leadership to move multiple priorities from insight to action, with global experience highly preferred.

• Collaborating with influence and integrity across global teams while building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne , Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé SA, your mission is to turn nutrition data into reliable insights, digital prototypes and reporting capabilities that support Nestlé’s Nutrition, Health and Wellness (NHW) strategy and strengthen the nutritional value of our product portfolio. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with the NHW, Research and Development, IT teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist

• Leading nutrition data analysis to support portfolio decisions.

• Building automated dashboards and reporting capabilities that improve accuracy, efficiency and visibility across global nutrition data.

• Driving data quality, validation and audit readiness to strengthen confidence in internal and external nutrition reporting.

• Developing digital prototypes and new automated functionalities that make nutrition reporting and benchmarking faster, smarter and easier to use.

• Delivering data-driven knowledge projects with clear plans, strong governance and high-quality scientific outputs.

• Nurturing cross-functional networks to understand business needs, share ideas and build digital nutrition capabilities at scale.

What will make you successful

• Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

• Bringing strong data analytics skills, ideally applied to nutrition, food data or scientific reporting.

• Proven previous experience, preferably in a food manufacturing or recipe management environment.

• Applying knowledge of recipe management, food regulations, nutrition labelling and data governance to create reliable outputs.

• Using data analysis, visualisation, database querying or programming tools to translate complex data into clear insights.

• Collaborating across functions, influencing with integrity and managing projects to deliver meaningful outcomes.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

• Strengthening scientific visibility through intellectual property, publications, conference presentations, and coaching of students and technicians.

What will make you successful

• Holding a PhD in Food Science/Chemistry, Food Engineering, or a related area, with strong knowledge of lipid science, including lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Applying analytical thinking and problem-solving to turn science and technology into consumer and business value.

• Using project management, organisation, and communication skills to deliver clear scientific outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across disciplines while showing initiative, integrity, and a passion for knowledge sharing.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: Tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: 2 anni contratto limitato

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione

Come Specialista Associato Lipids presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è di rafforzare le competenze scientifiche e generare nuove conoscenze nella fisica dei lipidi e nella chimica per le applicazioni alimentari. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di ricerca multidisciplinari, team di sviluppo di prodotti, reti di esperti, partner di innovazione, fornitori, università e istituti di ricerca. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Lipidi Specialista Associato

• Costruire la conoscenza scientifica dei metodi emergenti, delle tendenze e delle scoperte nella scienza e nella tecnologia dei lipidi.

• Sviluppare concetti scientifici robusti che traducono la ricerca lipidica in applicazioni alimentari e vantaggi per i consumatori.

• I principali progetti di ricerca e la comunicazione di approcci scientifici e risultati al pubblico tecnico e commerciale.

• Progettare ed eseguire studi di laboratorio che anticipano la comprensione della cristallizzazione dei lipidi, della strutturazione e dell'ossidazione.

• Trasferire conoscenze scientifiche ai team di sviluppo per accelerare i progetti di innovazione e lancio di prodotti di successo.

• Rafforzare la visibilità scientifica attraverso la proprietà intellettuale, pubblicazioni, presentazioni di conferenze e coaching di studenti e tecnici.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Tenendo un dottorato in Scienze alimentari / Chimica, Ingegneria alimentare, o una zona collegata, con una forte conoscenza della scienza dei lipidi, tra cui cristallizzazione dei lipidi, strutturazione e ossidazione.

• Applicare il pensiero analitico e risolvere i problemi per trasformare la scienza e la tecnologia in valore di consumo e di business.

• Utilizzo delle capacità di gestione del progetto, organizzazione e comunicazione per fornire risultati scientifici chiari.

• Collaborare attivamente attraverso le discipline, mostrando iniziativa, integrità e passione per la condivisione delle conoscenze.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: 2 Jahre beschränkter Vertrag

Gestaltung der Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen

Als Associate Specialist Lipids bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, die wissenschaftliche Expertise zu stärken und neue Erkenntnisse in der Lipidphysik und -chemie für Lebensmittelanwendungen zu generieren. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit multidisziplinären Forschungsteams, Produktentwicklungsteams, Expertennetzwerken, Innovationspartnern, Lieferanten, Universitäten und Forschungsinstituten zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Associate Specialist Lipids eine Wirkung erzielen

• Aufbau wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse über neue Methoden, Trends und Entdeckungen in der Lipidwissenschaft und -technologie.

• Entwicklung robuster wissenschaftlicher Konzepte, die die Lipidforschung in Lebensmittelanwendungen und Verbrauchervorteile umsetzen.

• Leitung von Forschungsprojekten und Vermittlung wissenschaftlicher Ansätze und Ergebnisse an technische und wirtschaftliche Zielgruppen.

• Entwerfen und Durchführen von Laborstudien, die das Verständnis von Lipidkristallisation, Strukturierung und Oxidation verbessern.

• Transfer wissenschaftlichen Wissens an Entwicklungsteams, um Innovationsprojekte und erfolgreiche Produkteinführungen zu beschleunigen.

• Stärkung der wissenschaftlichen Sichtbarkeit durch geistiges Eigentum, Publikationen, Konferenzpräsentationen und Coaching von Studenten und Technikern.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einen PhD in Food Science / Chemie, Food Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Lipidwissenschaft, einschließlich Lipidkristallisation, Strukturierung und Oxidation.

• Anwendung analytischen Denkens und Problemlösung, um Wissenschaft und Technologie in Verbraucher- und Geschäftswert zu verwandeln.

• Mit Projektmanagement, Organisation und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten klare wissenschaftliche Ergebnisse zu liefern.

• Proaktive Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen hinweg und gleichzeitig Initiative, Integrität und Leidenschaft für den Wissensaustausch.

• Fließend Englisch kommunizieren; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Modèle de travail: Temps plein
Type de contrat / durée: 2 ans contrat limité

Façonner l'avenir grâce aux percées scientifiques et à l'innovation

En tant que spécialiste associé des lipides chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de renforcer l'expertise scientifique et de générer de nouvelles connaissances en physique des lipides et en chimie pour les applications alimentaires. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec des équipes de recherche multidisciplinaires, des équipes de développement de produits, des réseaux d'experts, des partenaires d'innovation, des fournisseurs, des universités et des instituts de recherche. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste associé Lipids

• Développer les connaissances scientifiques sur les méthodes, les tendances et les découvertes émergentes en science et technologie des lipides.

• Élaborer des concepts scientifiques solides qui traduisent la recherche sur les lipides en applications alimentaires et en avantages pour les consommateurs.

• Diriger les projets de recherche et communiquer les approches et les résultats scientifiques aux publics techniques et commerciaux.

• Concevoir et exécuter des études de laboratoire qui permettent de mieux comprendre la cristallisation, la structuration et l'oxydation des lipides.

• Transférer les connaissances scientifiques aux équipes de développement pour accélérer les projets d'innovation et les lancements réussis de produits.

• Renforcer la visibilité scientifique par la propriété intellectuelle, les publications, les présentations de conférences et l'encadrement des étudiants et des techniciens.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences alimentaires/chimie, génie alimentaire, ou un domaine connexe, avec une solide connaissance de la science des lipides, y compris la cristallisation des lipides, la structuration et l'oxydation.

• Appliquer la réflexion analytique et la résolution de problèmes pour transformer la science et la technologie en valeur pour les consommateurs et les entreprises.

• Utiliser les compétences en gestion de projet, organisation et communication pour obtenir des résultats scientifiques clairs.

• Collaborer de façon proactive entre les disciplines tout en faisant preuve d'initiative, d'intégrité et d'une passion pour le partage des connaissances.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Selon le rôle, une évaluation vidéo peut être incluse. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

jobs.title: Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Research Konolfingen

Act. Rate: 80-100%

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Language: Fluent in English (B2 or better) and German (an advantage)

What we offer at Nestlé

Flexible work policies in terms of core hours. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you!

Genuine opportunities for career and personal development

Working in an international environment with the possibility to work worldwide after a successful experience in Konolfingen

Attractive additional benefits

Position summary

Our Nestlé Research and Development Center in Konolfingen (NRDK), Switzerland, develops for Nestlé worldwide, new products, processes and packaging concepts in the areas of Milk, plant-based and Nutrition products. This includes various process and filling technologies for liquid, powder or sterile products. In addition, it also provides technical assistance and engineering support for major Capital Investment Projects (CAPEX) to our factories.

As a member of our local Site-Engineering team you will support with your technical expertise and in close collaboration with your colleagues the daily pilot plant operations as well as the evaluation, design and implementation of local investment projects.

We offer a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment with many opportunities across different companies, functions, and regions. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and work with different teams in an agile and diverse context.

Daily activities of an Engineering Specialist

• Prepare high-level feasibility studies by asking the right questions to get a broad picture without going into too many details for new process and product ideas

• Prepare projects in further details to submit budget requests taking in account the various internal and external stakeholders of the NRDK

• Lead and execute the projects on site safely and in close collaboration with the various team members and specific operational functions leading to a successful commissioning, start-up and documented handover

• Assist our technicians/operators in troubleshooting and more complex root cause analysis on site

• Help to improve the asset intensity of our pilot plant and production facilities with detailed data analysis and specific process know-how

• Develop and drive sustainable solutions to meet our net zero goal by challenging and improving the status-quo

• Support the exploration and development of new technologies/products and help to qualify and industrialize them

What will make you successful

• Engineering degree (preferably process or mechanical engineering)

• Experience in process engineering and food industry including hygienic requirements are an advantage but not a must

• Excellent networking and communication skills

• End to end (E2E)-mindset (start projects with a clearly defined and well aligned scope ending up in successful handover including proper documentation)

• Passionate about making a difference in the professional environment

• Strong problem-solving skills as part of a bigger team and willing to apply them also in the field

• Full commitment to compliance (legal, safety, quality, finance) for all activities

• Willingness to develop specific expertise in defined areas to be the local subject matter expert

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win.
We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.
Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist in Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate R&D Specialist in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide scientific expertise in advanced lipid analytics to help developing, validating and transferring fit-for-purpose analytical methodologies to support product innovation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an associate R&D specialist in Lipids Analytics

• Leading project activities with independence, accuracy, and scientific rigor to meet defined objectives and timelines.

• Organizing laboratories activities and carrying out experiments involving internal or external partners.

• Driving the implementation of analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities in our Nestlé Operation sites across the world.

• Strengthening the scientific evidence on lipids to support breakthrough innovation.

• Contributing to technological scouting and drive continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD with recognized expertise in lipid analysis using advanced-analytics based on mass spectrometry techniques (HRMS and MS/MS) with 1-3 years of expertise in the domain.

• Leveraging operational and business needs and research thinking to develop, validate and transfer fit-for-purpose analytical methods to support product innovation.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity, agility and creativity across research and technology.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer.

We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Specialista R&D associato nel dipartimento Lipids & Metabolic Analytics presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire competenze scientifiche nell'analisi dei lipidi avanzata per aiutare a sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodologie analitiche adeguate per supportare l'innovazione del prodotto. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti, partner di innovazione e team tecnici in Nestlé. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come specialista R&D associato a Lipids Analytics

• Le principali attività di progetto con indipendenza, accuratezza e rigore scientifico per soddisfare obiettivi e tempi definiti.

• Organizzazione delle attività dei laboratori e realizzazione di esperimenti che coinvolgono partner interni o esterni.

• Guidare l'implementazione di metodi analitici e soluzioni tecniche che migliorano le capacità di analisi dei lipidi nei nostri siti di Nestlé Operation in tutto il mondo.

• Rafforzare le prove scientifiche sui lipidi per sostenere l'innovazione innovativa.

• Contribuire allo scouting tecnologico e a migliorare continuamente.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato con competenze riconosciute nell'analisi dei lipidi utilizzando analisi avanzate basate sulle tecniche di spettrometria di massa (HRMS e MS/MS) con 1-3 anni di esperienza nel dominio.

• Sfruttando le esigenze operative e aziendali e il pensiero di ricerca per sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodi analitici idonei a sostenere l'innovazione dei prodotti.

• Collaborare con una qualità focalizzata, proattiva e curiosità, agilità e creatività attraverso la ricerca e la tecnologia.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta.

Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

jobs.title: Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: On Site/Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler, your mission is to drive the product recipe lifecycle from new product brief to launch, ensuring compliant formulation, effective recipe management and ingredient specification excellence. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with operations, quality, manufacturing, product, research and development, regulatory and medical affairs teams across markets and factories. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler

• Lead compliant recipe development from product brief to launch, ensuring scientifically robust formulations across categories, factories, and markets.

• Translate formulation science into fit-for-purpose recipes by integrating ingredient functionality, nutrient targets, process losses, shelf-life evolution, and manufacturing feasibility.

• Embed compliance by design throughout innovation and renovation projects, ensuring validation, approvals, and documentation align with category rules, internal standards, and external requirements.

• Build technical capability by sharing formulation expertise, best practices, standards, and training with recipe and ingredient specialists, Product Developers, CTAGs, AGs, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Provide technical decision support through formulation proposals, trade-off assessments, variability analyses, and proactive risk mitigation across ingredients, quality, regulatory, nutrition, and manufacturing dimensions.

• Drive simplification and harmonization of recipes, ingredients, and specifications to reduce portfolio complexity, improve operational efficiency, and support scale-up or transfer activities.

• Be a force for continuous improvements by challenging existing practices and processes, improving existing tools, tracking and reporting to increase portfolio visibility.

• Safeguard business continuity by maintaining approval readiness, monitoring formulation-related KPIs, and responding effectively to compliance, data, or recipe management challenges.

What will make you successful

• Scientific education in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacist or a related field, combined with strong hands-on experience in recipe formulation, compliance, and management of nutritional or food products.

• Using analytical thinking, problem solving and digital tools to manage recipe data, good knowledge of statistical calculations.

• Solid understanding of ingredient contributions, process and shelf-life losses, manufacturing feasibility, and the regulatory environment, with the ability to translate these factors into compliant and robust recipe solutions.

• Experience working in cross-functional teams and strong proficiency in relevant systems and digital tools, including SAP-RM and an understanding of DevEX and CAT, together with excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Communicating fluently in English.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Junior Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop, validate and apply analytical methods for novel coated paper packaging materials. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teammates, research colleagues, operations teams, quality managers and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety

• Contribute to the development of robust analytical methods that help assess the safety and performance of innovative packaging materials.

• Perform packaging characterization analyses that support reliable research outcomes and project decisions.

• Consolidating and interpreting data and writing clear analytical documentation that enables quality, research and project teams to act with confidence.

• Participate in transferring analytical methods to operations and supporting end users throughout the method lifecycle.

• Contributing to quality, safety and knowledge-sharing practices that help teams work consistently across sites.

• Engage with internal and external partners to stay at the forefront of packaging safety science and analytical technologies.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry or a related scientific discipline, combined with a strong interest in analytical sciences, packaging safety and sustainable packaging technologies.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry or material characterization.

• Using hands-on laboratory experience from academic projects, internships or research activities to deliver reliable experimental work.

• Collaborating with curiosity, attention to detail and strong data analysis, problem-solving and scientific reporting skills.

• Working proficiency in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

jobs.title: Associate Robotics Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based, full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate Robotics Specialist at the Nestlé Deep Tech Center , your mission is to help identify, evaluate, develop and deploy advanced robotics and intelligent automation solutions that turn emerging technologies into scalable manufacturing solutions. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission and deliver meaningful results that shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Robotics Specialist

• Building and applying robotics expertise to unlock smarter, safer and more efficient manufacturing solutions.

• Scouting and evaluating emerging technologies that can become practical, scalable automation concepts.

• Supporting robotics projects from early opportunity framing through proof of concept, pilot and industrial deployment.

• Delivering work packages across requirements, design reviews, commissioning, start-up and qualification with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.

• Translating validated concepts into maintainable automation solutions that can be reused across different use cases and environments.

• Sharing knowledge, documentation and training content that strengthens adoption and builds robotics capability across our community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing hands-on knowledge of robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial artificial intelligence or advanced engineering projects.

• Applying practical exposure to robotics integration, end-of-arm manipulation, mobile robotics, machine vision, sensors or robot safety.

• Using programming, data analysis, simulation or digital twin tools to support robust technical recommendations and solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and operational teams with proactivity, autonomy, comfort with ambiguity and a strong focus on safety and quality.

• Communicating confidently in English and presenting technical ideas clearly to diverse audiences; French is a plus.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment and being ready to move fast from concept to reality, while translating ideas into measurable impact

At Nestlé Deep Tech Center, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

Nestlé is an inclusive employer and, if needed, we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout your journey with us. All information is treated confidentially.

Our workplace is fully barrier free with step free access, elevators to all floors, and accessible restrooms. We also maintain a strong safety culture, supported by modern installations and procedures to ensure a secure environment for everyone.

Our hiring process typically includes application review, a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications on a rolling basis and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early.

You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission and deliver meaningful results that shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Robotics Specialist

• Building and applying robotics expertise to unlock smarter, safer and more efficient manufacturing solutions.

• Scouting and evaluating emerging technologies that can become practical, scalable automation concepts.

• Supporting robotics projects from early opportunity framing through proof of concept, pilot and industrial deployment.

• Delivering work packages across requirements, design reviews, commissioning, start-up and qualification with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.

• Translating validated concepts into maintainable automation solutions that can be reused across different use cases and environments.

• Sharing knowledge, documentation and training content that strengthens adoption and builds robotics capability across our community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing hands-on knowledge of robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial artificial intelligence or advanced engineering projects.

• Applying practical exposure to robotics integration, end-of-arm manipulation, mobile robotics, machine vision, sensors or robot safety.

• Using programming, data analysis, simulation or digital twin tools to support robust technical recommendations and solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and operational teams with proactivity, autonomy, comfort with ambiguity and a strong focus on safety and quality.

• Communicating confidently in English and presenting technical ideas clearly to diverse audiences; French is a plus.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment and being ready to move fast from concept to reality, while translating ideas into measurable impact

At Nestlé Deep Tech Center, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

Nestlé is an inclusive employer and, if needed, we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout your journey with us. All information is treated confidentially.

Our workplace is fully barrier free with step free access, elevators to all floors, and accessible restrooms. We also maintain a strong safety culture, supported by modern installations and procedures to ensure a secure environment for everyone.

Our hiring process typically includes application review, a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications on a rolling basis and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

jobs.description:
Übersicht Position

Standort: Fabrik Konolfingen, Schweiz
Unternehmen: Nestlé Schweiz S.A.
Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: Unbefristet
Anstellungsbeginn: 1. August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits

• 41 Stunden pro Woche

• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien (Abstufung nach Alter)

• Kostenfreier Parkplatz

• Rabatt im Nestlé Shop (vor Ort in Konolfingen)

• Einstieg mit vielversprechenden Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung und persönlichen Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

550 Mitarbeitende, die für die Herstellung hochwertiger Säuglingsnahrung für das In- und Ausland zuständig sind, prägen das dynamische, hochautomatisierte Arbeitsumfeld der Fabrik Konolfingen.

Aufgrund einer anstehenden Pensionierung eines langjährigen Mitarbeiters suchen wir Sie, als engagierte Persönlichkeit für den Bereich Endverpackung , innerhalb der Abteilung Engineering.

Es erwarten Sie interessante, abwechslungsreiche und herausfordernde Aufgaben, bei denen Sicherheit, Qualität, Lieferbereitschaft und Kostenbewusstsein im Vordergrund stehen. Als Instandhaltungsmechaniker im Schichtbetrieb tragen Sie mit Ihren Kollegen massgeblich dazu bei, dass sich unsere Produktionslinien immer in bestem Zustand befinden und unsere Operativen Abteilungen alle Voraussetzungen zur Verfügung haben, die Produktion nach höchsten Ansprüchen durchzuführen. Mit Neugier, Engagement und Teamgeist bereichern Sie unser Team und übernehmen dabei die nachfolgenden vielfältigen und spannenden Aufgaben:

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Instandhalter:In Mechanik

• Instandhaltung der vielfältigen und modernen Produktionsanlagen:

• Störungsbehebungen

• Wartungen/Inspektionen

• Geplante Instandsetzungen

• Optimierungen (KVP)

• Leisten von Pikettdienst

• Teilnahme an spezifischen Arbeitsgruppen

• Dokumentation von Instandhaltungsarbeiten

• Erkennen, Verbessern und Korrigieren von technischen Schwachstellen

• Erstellen von Arbeitsanweisungen und Schulung der Techniker:Innen und Produktionsmitarbeiter:Innen

• Saubere und ordentliche Arbeitsweise

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Maschinenmechaniker, Polymechaniker oder vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Einige Jahre Erfahrung als Betriebsmechaniker im industriellen Bereich sind von Vorteil

• Belastbare, zuverlässige und teamfähige Persönlichkeit

• Selbständige, strukturierte und exakte Arbeitsweise

• Besonnene und zuverlässige Wesensart

• Eigeninitiative und hohes Mass an Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Kenntnisse in MS-Office Produkten (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Erfahrung in SAP oder Bereitschaft diese zu erwerben

• Bewilligung eingeschränkte Installationen (NIV-15), bzw. wir bieten die Möglichkeit diese zu absolvieren.

Wir bei Nestlé wollen dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und in einem Umfang und Tempo zu arbeiten, das einen Unterschied macht. Wir tun dies, indem wir ein vielfältiges, freundliches, unterstützendes und kollaboratives Umfeld fördern, das positiven Wandel hervorruft, Innovationen begrüsst und Menschen und Teams befähigt, zu gewinnen. Werden Sie Teil von Nestlé und besuchen Sie uns auf https://www.nestle.ch/de.

Sie möchten für die ganz Kleinen auf dieser Welt Grosses bewirken? Werden Sie Teil von Nestlé und senden uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome etc.) direkt online zu.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to contribute to the design and delivery of coffee and cocoa regenerative agriculture research aligned with corporate Creating Shared Value commitments and the business-endorsed Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences research strategy. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with agricultural systems teams, project leaders, researchers, agronomists, operations teams, farmers, research institutes, universities and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)

• Implementing regenerative agriculture research that advance the creation of shared value in coffee and cocoa production systems.

• Coordinate state-of-the-art field trials, data collection, and analysis with internal teams and external partners.

• Use scientific rigour to turn high-quality data collection into robust research outputs.

• Convert research findings into practical guidance and recommendations for on-farm deployment.

• Deliver novel research insights within agreed timelines, milestones, standards, and budgets.

• Build regenerative agriculture expertise to strengthen team performance and scientific collaboration.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD in agronomy, agriculture, plant science or a related discipline along with practical experience in agricultural research, field trials or applied agronomy, ideally with exposure to coffee or cocoa.

• Applying regenerative agriculture, crop management and soil health knowledge to deliver robust research outcomes.

• Using data analysis, documentation and reporting tools to create clear, traceable and actionable technical outputs.

• Collaborating across scientific, technical and operational audiences with practical problem solving, attention to detail and timely communication.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

jobs.title: Demand & Supply Planner
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

jobs.title: Accounting Specialist - Nestlé Waters
jobs.description:
Location: Henniez, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target Start Date: November 2026 or upon agreement

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As an Accounting Specialist at Nestlé Waters, your mission is to manage and analyse financial information, ensure accurate accounting and reporting, and support effective business decision-making. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Finance and Control colleagues, internal business teams and external stakeholders. This is your opportunity to deliver meaningful results that unlock the future of beverages and experiences that elevate everyday living.

How you’ll make an impact as an Accounting Specialist

• Delivering accurate and timely accounting, financial analysis and reporting across your areas of responsibility.

• Driving monthly closing activities, journal entries and balance sheet reviews to maintain reliable financial records.

• Preparing transparent forecasts of the overheads and analysing performance against budgets to support informed business decisions.

• Ensuring strong governance, internal controls and compliance through audit support and accurate statutory declarations.

• Managing treasury information, current accounts, asset records and master data to strengthen financial visibility and control.

• Coaching and supporting the Finance apprentice while collaborating closely with Finance colleagues and cost owners to translate financial data into meaningful business insights.

What will make you successful

• Bringing very good knowledge of accounting and controlling principles, Swiss accounting standards and month-end closing processes.

• Applying good knowledge of controlling principles, financial analysis, budgeting and forecasting.

• Using SAP and Microsoft Office tools to support accounting, reporting and financial performance management activities.

• Collaborating proactively with internal stakeholders while demonstrating autonomy, accuracy and strong attention to detail.

• Communicating fluently in French and English; German is an advantage.

• Bringing to life our values of care, grit, connection and ingenuity, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé Waters, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Work model: Hybrid / Full time

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Proficiency Testing Coordinator at Nestlé Research, your mission is to plan, coordinate, and manage internal proficiency tests from test design to final result reporting while supporting external schemes and delivering reliable insights for continuous improvement. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with R&D teams, quality experts, laboratories, factories, technology partners, and external proficiency testing providers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Proficiency Testing Coordinator

• Coordinating internal proficiency testing schemes that help laboratories deliver reliable, comparable, and high-quality analytical results.

• Managing the full testing cycle, from scheme design and sample coordination to data evaluation, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

• Partnering with internal experts and external providers to ensure smooth delivery of standard and tailored proficiency testing programs.

• Strengthening quality and compliance by supporting accredited processes, customer feedback follow-up, and continuous improvement actions.

• Delivering consolidated reports and insights that support management decisions, stakeholder engagement, and program performance.

• Supporting digital tools and users by following up on application improvements, issue resolution, and service excellence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a chemistry background through a CFC, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification, combined with at least three years of hands-on laboratory experience.

• Applying experience or a strong interest in quality assurance, proficiency testing, and laboratory quality systems to support reliable testing outcomes.

• Using good laboratory practices, statistical methods, and accredited quality requirements to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement.

• Collaborating with a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, strong organization, and the initiative to solve problems efficiently.

• Communicating fluently in English.
