As a Proficiency Testing Coordinator at Nestlé Research, your mission is to plan, coordinate, and manage internal proficiency tests from test design to final result reporting while supporting external schemes and delivering reliable insights for continuous improvement. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with R&D teams, quality experts, laboratories, factories, technology partners, and external proficiency testing providers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Proficiency Testing Coordinator

• Coordinating internal proficiency testing schemes that help laboratories deliver reliable, comparable, and high-quality analytical results.

• Managing the full testing cycle, from scheme design and sample coordination to data evaluation, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

• Partnering with internal experts and external providers to ensure smooth delivery of standard and tailored proficiency testing programs.

• Strengthening quality and compliance by supporting accredited processes, customer feedback follow-up, and continuous improvement actions.

• Delivering consolidated reports and insights that support management decisions, stakeholder engagement, and program performance.

• Supporting digital tools and users by following up on application improvements, issue resolution, and service excellence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a chemistry background through a CFC, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification, combined with at least three years of hands-on laboratory experience.

• Applying experience or a strong interest in quality assurance, proficiency testing, and laboratory quality systems to support reliable testing outcomes.

• Using good laboratory practices, statistical methods, and accredited quality requirements to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement.

• Collaborating with a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, strong organization, and the initiative to solve problems efficiently.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Automaticien.ne & Spécialiste Digital
jobs.description:
Division « Eau » du groupe Nestlé, Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA est le leader suisse du marché des eaux minérales avec des marques telles que Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier et Acqua Panna, ainsi que d’autres grandes marques de boissons sans alcool.

Résumé de la position

Lieu de travail: Henniez

Type de contrat: Contrat à durée indéterminée

Taux de travail: 80%-100%

En tant qu' Automaticien(ne) & Spécialiste Digital , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le bon fonctionnement de nos installations de production et dans la digitalisation de l’usine. Véritable référent technique, vous assurerez la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation, participerez aux dépannages et contribuerez au développement des outils digitaux qui soutiennent nos opérations au quotidien.

Un jour dans la vie d’un(e) Automaticien(ne) & Spécialiste Digital

• Assurer le bon fonctionnement et la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation de l’usine.

• Diagnostiquer les pannes et participer activement aux interventions sur le terrain.

• Améliorer les programmes, équipements et systèmes afin d’optimiser la performance des lignes de production.

• Développer la maintenance préventive et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des équipements.

• Participer à l’installation, au démarrage et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements.

• Assurer le support et le développement des outils digitaux de l’usine (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, etc.).

• Garantir la fiabilité des échanges de données entre les équipements de production, les systèmes de supervision et les applications digitales.

• Assurer le rôle d’administrateur FAS (Factory Automation System) du site.

• Maintenir à jour la documentation technique, les standards et les équipements critiques.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC d’Automaticien(n), Électronicien(n) ou formation jugée équivalente avec expérience dans un environnement industriel

• Connaissances des automates Siemens et des réseaux industriels.

• Intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies, l’automation et la digitalisation industrielle.

• Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques ; une expérience avec SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps ou POKA constitue un atout.

• Esprit d’analyse, autonomie et orientation solutions.

• Goût pour le travail de terrain et la résolution de problèmes techniques.

• Excellentes capacités de collaboration et de communication.

• Français courant ; anglais technique un atout.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nestlé Waters (Svizzera) è leader svizzero nel mercato delle acque minerali con marchi come Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier e Acqua Panna, nonché altri marchi leader di bevande senza alcol.

Sintesi della posizione

Luogo di lavoro: Henniez

Tipo di contratto: Contratto permanente

Tasso di lavoro: 80%-100%

Come Specialista Automatico & Digitale, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel corretto funzionamento delle nostre strutture produttive e nella digitalizzazione della fabbrica. Vero riferimento tecnico, garantirai l'affidabilità dei sistemi di automazione, parteciperai alla risoluzione dei problemi e contribuirai allo sviluppo di strumenti digitali che supportano le nostre operazioni quotidiane.

Un giorno nella vita di un Automatico & Digital Specialist

• Assicurare il corretto funzionamento e l'affidabilità dei sistemi di automazione degli impianti.

• Diagnosi dei guasti e partecipazione attiva alle operazioni sul campo.

• Migliorare programmi, attrezzature e sistemi per ottimizzare le prestazioni della linea di produzione.

• Sviluppare la manutenzione preventiva e contribuire al continuo miglioramento delle attrezzature.

• Partecipa all'installazione, all'avvio e alla messa in servizio di nuove attrezzature.

• Assicurare il supporto e lo sviluppo di strumenti digitali di fabbrica (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, ecc.).

• Garantire uno scambio di dati affidabile tra attrezzature di produzione, sistemi di supervisione e applicazioni digitali.

• Per agire come amministratore FAS (Factory Automation System) del sito.

• Mantenere la documentazione tecnica, gli standard e le attrezzature critiche.

Che cosa farà il vostro successo

• SWC (n), Electrician(n) o formazione equivalente con esperienza in un ambiente industriale

• Conoscenza dell'automazione Siemens e delle reti industriali.

• Interessi in nuove tecnologie, automazione e digitalizzazione industriale.

• Un buon controllo degli strumenti informatici; l'esperienza con SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps o POKA è un bene.

• Spirito di analisi, autonomia e soluzioni di orientamento.

• Gusto per il lavoro sul campo e risolvere problemi tecnici.

• Ottima capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione.

• Francese attuale; inglese tecnico un bene.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Nestlé Waters (Switzerland) is the Swiss leader in the mineral water market with brands such as Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier and Acqua Panna, as well as other leading brands of alcohol-free beverages.

Summary of position

Place of work: Henniez

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Work rate: 80%-100%

As an Automatician & Digital Specialist, you will play a key role in the proper functioning of our production facilities and in the digitization of the factory. True technical reference, you will ensure the reliability of automation systems, participate in troubleshooting and contribute to the development of digital tools that support our daily operations.

One day in the life of an Automatician & Digital Specialist

• Ensure the proper functioning and reliability of plant automation systems.

• Diagnosing breakdowns and participating actively in field operations.

• Improve programs, equipment and systems to optimize production line performance.

• Develop preventive maintenance and contribute to the continuous improvement of equipment.

• Participate in the installation, start-up and commissioning of new equipment.

• Ensure support and development of factory digital tools (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, etc.).

• Ensure reliable data exchange between production equipment, supervisory systems and digital applications.

• To act as the FAS (Factory Automation System) administrator of the site.

• Maintain technical documentation, standards and critical equipment.

What Will Make Your Success

• SWCs (n), Electrician(n) or equivalent training with experience in an industrial environment

• Knowledge of Siemens automation and industrial networks.

• Interest in new technologies, automation and industrial digitalisation.

• Good control of computer tools; experience with SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps or POKA is an asset.

• Spirit of analysis, autonomy and orientation solutions.

• Taste for field work and solving technical problems.

• Excellent collaboration and communication capabilities.

• Current French; technical English an asset.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Nestlé Waters (Schweiz) ist der Schweizer Marktführer im Mineralwassermarkt mit Marken wie Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier und Acqua Panna sowie anderen führenden Marken alkoholfreier Getränke.

Zusammenfassung der Position

Arbeitsort: Henniez

Art des Vertrags: unbefristeter Vertrag

Arbeitsrate: 80%-100%

Als Automatician & Digital Specialist spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle für den ordnungsgemäßen Betrieb unserer Produktionsstätten und die Digitalisierung der Fabrik. Echte technische Referenz, Sie werden die Zuverlässigkeit von Automatisierungssystemen gewährleisten, an der Fehlersuche teilnehmen und zur Entwicklung digitaler Tools beitragen, die unseren täglichen Betrieb unterstützen.

Ein Tag im Leben eines Automatikers und Digitalspezialisten

• Gewährleistung des ordnungsgemäßen Funktionierens und der Zuverlässigkeit der Anlagenautomationssysteme.

• Diagnose von Pannen und aktive Teilnahme an Feldoperationen.

• Verbessern Sie Programme, Ausrüstung und Systeme, um die Leistung der Produktionslinie zu optimieren.

• Entwicklung einer vorbeugenden Wartung und Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Ausrüstung.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Inbetriebnahme neuer Geräte.

• Sicherstellen von Support und Entwicklung von Factory Digital Tools (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA usw.).

• Gewährleistung eines zuverlässigen Datenaustauschs zwischen Produktionsanlagen, Aufsichtssystemen und digitalen Anwendungen.

• Als FAS (Factory Automation System) Administrator der Website zu fungieren.

• Pflegen Sie die technische Dokumentation, Normen und kritische Ausrüstung.

Was wird Ihren Erfolg machen

• SWCs (n), Elektriker (n) oder gleichwertige Ausbildung mit Erfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld

• Wissen über Siemens Automatisierung und industrielle Netzwerke.

• Interesse an neuen Technologien, Automatisierung und industrieller Digitalisierung.

• Gute Kontrolle über Computer-Tools; Erfahrung mit SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps oder POKA ist ein Gewinn.

• Geist der Analyse, Autonomie und Orientierung Lösungen.

• Geschmack an Feldarbeit und Lösung technischer Probleme.

• Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Aktuelles Französisch; technisches Englisch ein Asset.

jobs.title: Specialist Biostatistician
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Specialist Biostatistician at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide statistical expertise across clinical trials, from study design and analysis planning to programming, reporting and scientific communication. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with clinical teams, study sponsors, project managers, research partners and external providers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Specialist Biostatistician

• Providing statistical expertise that strengthens clinical study design, aligns scientific objectives with robust statistical hypotheses and supports evidence generation for nutrition, medical nutrition and pharmaceutical assets.

• Developing high-quality clinical protocols and statistical analysis plans to support clear study execution.

• Programming statistical analyses in R or SAS to deliver accurate, reproducible and well-organized results that enable confident decision-making.

• Presenting clinical trial results in a clear and meaningful way, helping teams interpret findings and translate data into scientific evidence.

• Driving quality, risk management and continuous improvement across clinical trial statistics and data analysis practices.

• Sharing knowledge and mentoring colleagues to build capability, consistency and scientific excellence across the biostatistics team.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong biostatistics and clinical trial expertise to support high-quality scientific evidence generation for nutrition, medical nutrition and pharmaceutical assets.

• Applying analytical thinking, organization and project management skills to deliver reliable results in a complex research environment.

• Using statistical programming as well as clinical research standards such as ICH GCP, EMA, FDA, CDISC guidelines to support compliant and effective study delivery.

• Collaborating with scientific and business partners through clear communication, curiosity and a quality-focused mindset.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Embracing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Activity rate: 100%

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern in Food Physics, Materials Science and Coffee Innovation , your mission is to help implement inline measurement technology and explore how coffee-processing parameters influence freeze-dried coffee. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project, science, laboratory, pilot plant and technical workshop teams. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern in Food Physics, Materials Science and Coffee Innovation

• Collaborating with project, science, laboratory, pilot plant and technical workshop teams to advance coffee innovation

• Coordinating the installation and integration of measurement probes on an existing coffee production line

• Operating specialized measurement equipment and data acquisition systems to generate reliable insights

• Designing and delivering a structured experimental plan to evaluate the effects of coffee-processing parameters

• Analysing product and process data, drawing clear conclusions and presenting recommendations to the wider project team

What will make you successful

• Current student or fresh graduate in chemical engineering, food science, materials science or a related field

• Being a team player, curious, proactive and ready to learn how to operate specialized equipment safely and confidently

• Having strong planning, analytical and communication skills to turn complex data into clear conclusions

• Communicating fluently in English; knowledge of French is an advantage

Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Deadline for applications: 7th August 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Senior Engineer/Senior R&D Specialist Systems Innovation at Nestlé NPTC, your mission is to lead research and early-stage innovation for new coffee systems, from idea generation and concept design to pre-development and know-how transfer. A coffee system combines the machine, the beverage ingredients (e.g., capsule, pod, or sachet), and the preparation process to create a unique consumer experience.

You’ll work closely with business partners, primarily Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto, as well as operations, research and development teams, suppliers, universities, and technology partners. Whether your passion is microengineering, mechatronics, machine design, or connected products, you will have the opportunity to explore new technologies, turn ideas into prototypes, grow your expertise, and help shape the next generation of coffee experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers around the world.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Engineer/Senior R&D Specialist Systems Innovation

• Leading research projects and early-stage innovation behind the next generation of Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto systems.

• Driving the development of technical components, subsystems and system building blocks that support future beverage experiences.

• Identifying technology trends, competitor developments and consumer insights to shape a strong innovation pipeline.

• Turn ideas into reality through rapid prototyping, testing, experimentation, and technology exploration, and validate new solutions for machines, capsules, products and preparation methods.

• Coordinating internal and external partners to deliver projects on time, within budget and in line with quality, safety and compliance expectations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in machine design, system performance, machine intelligence, components, materials and quality by design.

• Bringing strong expertise in embedded systems (hardware and software development), inter-connected devices, signal processing and data acquisition for systems.

• Using prototyping (in mechanics and electronics), computer-aided design, simulations and testing methods to create, assess and refine innovative technical concepts.

• Collaborating with confidence across functions, suppliers and business partners while managing priorities, timelines, risks and project costs.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Community Manager at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen employee engagement, belonging, and connection across Nestlé Research and the wider Research and Development community. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with employees, leaders, sites, functions, and communities.

How you’ll make an impact as a Community Manager

• Strengthening employee engagement and belonging through meaningful initiatives that connect people across sites and communities.

• Creating engaging communication moments, campaigns, events, and digital content that inspire participation and shared purpose.

• Building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels to connect people needs with business priorities.

• Facilitating conversations and translating complex topics into clear, accessible messages that build understanding and momentum.

jobs.title: R&D Packaging Development Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Start Date: January/February 2027
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an R&D Packaging Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre (NPTC), your mission is to support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body and contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams, as well as packaging material suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging innovation while working on a strategic sustainability and industrialization project.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Packaging Development Intern

• Support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body by contributing to packaging material evaluation, testing and documentation

• Contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project through laboratory work, pilot trials and supplier or factory testing activities

• Collaborate with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, quality and sustainability expectations

• Prepare clear presentations, test reports and technical summaries to support project decisions and stakeholder alignment

• Interact with packaging material suppliers and external partners to follow up on trials, results and next steps in an agile project environment

What will make you successful

• Fresh graduate or current student in Materials Science, Packaging, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

jobs.title: Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop and manage analytical methods that support food compliance, chemical contaminant risk assessment, and risk mitigation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with team and project members, technical services, analytical groups, business partners, quality teams, technology providers, and external suppliers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry

• Developing analytical methods that strengthen food safety, compliance, and chemical contaminant risk assessment.

• Managing advanced laboratory equipment to deliver reliable data and high-quality analytical results.

• Driving method validation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement in line with quality standards.

• Supporting technical assistance to markets and partners with practical recommendations and robust troubleshooting.

• Contributing to scientific reports, laboratory procedures, publications, and clear communication of analytical outcomes.

• Coaching apprentices and students while sharing technical knowledge across teams and working areas.

• Ensuring good laboratory practices, and promoting a mindset of safety in the laboratory

What will make you successful

• Bringing a background in analytical chemistry, such as a CFC, HES, Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification.

• Applying hands-on industrial experience in analytical chemistry to deliver reliable methods, results, and technical support.

• Using strong expertise in liquid chromatography and gas chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry techniques, including related instruments and software.

• Applying assessment of rapid methods (e.g. lateral-flow assays) against method requirements

• Collaborating proactively across teams, taking initiative, staying well organized, and contributing to a positive team environment.

• Communicating proficiently in English and in French, especially in reading and writing.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Performance based bonus

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

jobs.title: Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D)
jobs.description:
Chez Nespresso Suisse nous pensons qu’il est possible d’élever l’univers du café et nous voulons contribuer positivement à changer les vies et les paysages pour le mieux. Élu meilleur employeur 2025, nous plaçons chacun de nos 14 000 collaborateurs, sans exception, au cœur de notre réussite. Pour y parvenir, nous adoptons quatre comportements essentiels : « we Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate ». Et vous ? Voulez-vous nous accompagner dans cette aventure passionnante ? Rejoignez l’équipe Nespresso ! Et réimaginez la nature du café. Réimaginez votre avenir.

Instantané du poste

Lieux : Romont, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nespresso
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Ce que nous offrons chez Nespresso

De réelles opportunités d’évolution de carrière et de développement personnel

Un cadre de travail flexible facilitant la créativité et la collaboration

Une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusivité, où chacun peut être soi-même

La qualité et la durabilité au cœur de notre identité et une vision essentielle pour favoriser le changement positif L’opportunité de travailler pour une entreprise certifiée B Corp, et l'une des marques les plus fiables et appréciées à l’échelle mondiale

Au cours du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en parler pour en savoir plus !

Découvrez notre page Linkedin Nespresso Centres de production

Découvrez nos métiers Métiers Nespresso - YouTube

Résumé du poste

En tant qu’Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D) , vous êtes responsable de la conduite d’une ligne de production automatisée, en horaires d’équipe 4x8.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D)

• Conduire les installations de production automatisées

• Réapprovisionner les lignes de production

jobs.title: Operationeller Einkäufer
jobs.description:
Arbeitsort: Basel, Schweiz

Arbeitsmodell: 50% vor Ort, oder Home Office nach Vereinbarung (max. 40% der Arbeitszeit)

Art des Vertrags: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Zusammenfassung der Stelle

Die Fabrik Basel ist ein leistungsstarker Produktionsbetrieb der Nestlé Suisse S.A. und stellt kulinarische Produkte der Marke THOMY für das In- und Ausland her. Für unsere Abteilung Engineering suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Person als technische:n Einkäufer:in (m/w). Sie sind verantwortlich für die operative und administrative Beschaffung von technischen Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Sie stellen sicher, dass Materialien und Dienstleistungen termingerecht, wirtschaftlich und in der geforderten Qualität beschafft werden

Ein Tag im Leben eines technische:n Einkäufer:in 50%

• Einholen, Vergleichen und Auswerten von Angeboten anhand technischer Spezifikationen

• Durchführung von Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten

• Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Bestellungen im SAP

• Überwachung von Lieferterminen sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten Materialverfügbarkeit

• Kaufmännische Abwicklung des gesamten Beschaffungsprozesses

• Prüfung und Bearbeitung von Auftragsbestätigungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen

• Pflege von Lieferanten- und Materialstammdaten im SAP-System

• Unterstützung bei Lieferantenbewertungen und Lieferantenentwicklungen

• Bearbeitung von Reklamationen und Abweichungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen

• Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit Technik, Produktion, Projektleitung und Finanzwesen

• Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Einkaufsprozessen und Beschaffungsstrategien in Abstimmung mit unserem Zentraleinkauf

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien

Was macht dich erfolgreich

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre (technisch oder kaufmännisch) oder langjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position

• Vorteilsweise gute SAP-Kenntnisse

• Vorteilsweise technische Grundausbildung oder technisches Flair

• Proaktives Organisationstalent mit hoher Dienstleistungsorientierung

• Gutes Verhandlungsgeschick mit Lieferanten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Französisch und Englisch von Vorteil

Was wir bieten

• Eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen eines 50 %-Pensums

• Moderne Arbeitsmittel und zeitgemässe Arbeitsbedingungen

• Kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld

• Möglichkeit zur aktiven Mitgestaltung und Optimierung von Einkaufsprozessen

• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen

Wir bei Nestlé möchten dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und in einem Umfang und Tempo etwas zu bewirken, das einen Unterschied acht. Wir tun dies, indem wir ein vielfältiges, freundliches, unterstützendes und kollaboratives Umfeld fördern, das positive Störungen erzeugt, Innovationen annimmt und Menschen und Teams befähigt, erfolgreich zu sein.

Unser Ziel ist es, freundliche, respektvolle und inspirierende Menschen einzustellen, denen das Leben der Menschen, die wir jeden Tag berühren, am Herzen liegt.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben von Menschen und unseren Planeten verbessern.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Ingénieur-e S&H (Safety & Health)
jobs.description:
Lieu : Stages disponibles sur les centres de production d’Orbe et de Romont
Taux : temps plein 100%
Type de contrat : contrat de stage à durée déterminée (6 mois)
Quand : démarrage souhaité 1er trimestre 2027

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become

En qualité de Stagiaire Sécurité et Santé au travail , vous participerez à la préparation, à la mise en œuvre et au suivi de la politique sécurité de l’entreprise en soutenant les différents secteurs d’une usine de production.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Sécurité et Santé au travail ?

• Participer au suivi et au contrôle des actions SH
• Aider à la promotion de la santé et sécurité et au développement d’une culture sécurité
• Participer à l’animation des modules de formation (construction / préparation / animation)
• Participer aux analyses d’accident/incident ou aux risques ainsi qu’aux audits externes/internes SH
• Coacher les opérateurs de ligne à l’utilisation et à la compréhension des outils SH, dans l’exécution des standards
• Mettre à jour les indicateurs et assurer le reporting
• Participer au management des aspects SH dans le cadre des projets et effectuer les SH statements
• Faire des propositions d’amélioration des performances SH du site

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Elève Ingénieur-e technique sécurité santé environnement
• Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire et à s’adapter facilement aux changements
• Aisance en communication, organisé, structuré et réactif
• Français courant, anglais un plus.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Stagiaire ingénieur-e en efficacité énergétique
jobs.description:
Lieu : Centre de Production Nespresso Romont - Switzerland
Taux : Temps plein 100%
Type de contrat : Contrat de stage de 6 mois.
Démarrage souhaité : début 2027

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e en Efficacité Energétique , vous allez contribuer à construire et maintenir le schéma énergétique de notre centre de production, nous aider à établir la vision future de nos énergies au travers de roadmaps et piloter des actions et projets visant à optimiser nos consommations énergétiques.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e en Efficacité Energétique ?

• A l’aide de la méthodologie DMAIC vous devrez :
• Définir le fonctionnement de notre réseau de distribution d’eau chaude et d’eau glacée et d’eau de refroidissement sur notre site en prenant en compte leurs interactions.
• Mettre en place des indicateurs pour suivre la performance du système
• Proposer un plan d’amélioration pour améliorer les performances énergétiques de ces 3 réseaux
• Mettre en œuvre ce plan d’amélioration par la gestion de petits projets
• Modification des boucles de régulation
• Modification / améliorations techniques des installations
• Veille technologique / Benchmark / matrice de choix
• Pérenniser la mise en place de vos actions via la formation de nos équipes et la mise à jour de nos standards.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Diplôme d'ingénieur-e, de préférence mécanique, énergétique, thermique, chimie ou électricité (en cours de formation niveau Master ou Bachelor)
• Connaissances en gestion de projet
• Capacité à analyser les données et à proposer des solutions basées sur des faits.
• Bonnes compétences en communication et esprit d'équipe
• Bonne connaissance des outils informatiques tels que MS Office, Power BI
• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Senior Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Lausanne or Vevey with flexibility to commute to the other sites (2-4 times/month)
Work model: On site / Hybrid

Activity rate: 80% -100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent Contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant at Nestlé Product Technology Centre, your mission will be to maximize the effectiveness of the R&D Centre Head and leadership team by acting as a trusted support partner in a high-exposure position.

You will play a pivotal role in enabling senior leaders to operate effectively across a complex, multi-site R&D environment, and will bring strong judgment, anticipation, prioritization and stakeholder management skills, while coordinating sensitive operational topics with autonomy and discretion.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant

• Act as a trusted support partner to the NPTC Head and Leadership Team, enabling strategic focus and effective decision-making.

• Manage complex calendars, priorities and schedules, anticipating conflicts and ensuring timely preparation and follow-up.

• Prepare agendas, minutes, action tracking and key documents with accuracy, structure and confidentiality.

• Coordinate collaboration and information flow across Vevey, Konolfingen and other NPTC units.

• Organize leadership meetings, site events and complex workshops, including logistics, content and follow-up.

• Maintain SharePoint and intranet content, ensuring accurate and accessible information.

• Review and enhance presentations, documents and leadership communications for clarity and impact.

• Handle sensitive information with sound judgment, professionalism and discretion.

• Support newcomer onboarding and communication to help them navigate the organization.

• Provide autonomous support on audits, reporting, follow-ups and ad hoc operational priorities.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience in a senior administrative, executive assistant, coordination or project support role within an international, matrixed and fast-moving organization.

• Strong ability to manage complexity, anticipate needs, prioritize competing demands and keep senior stakeholders aligned and informed.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams, with confidence in preparing high-quality documents, presentations and simple data follow-ups.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt messages for different senior stakeholders; French and/or German would be an asset in this multi-site environment.

• A proactive, resilient and solutions-oriented mindset, demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.description:

Work model: Hybrid, primarily on site with occasional home-office flexibility
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Activity rate: Monday to Friday, 100%
Target start date: January/February 2027

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an F&B Manager at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead and empower a diverse hospitality team to deliver exceptional experiences across every food and beverage occasion, from daily operations and table service to premium internal and external events. Combining creativity, innovation, and operational excellence, you will ensure consistently high standards while creating memorable experiences for guests and stakeholders. You’ll make a difference by setting a clear direction, fostering a strong service culture, and bringing together site leaders, culinary researchers, hospitality partners, suppliers, and event professionals around a shared vision of excellence. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Food & Beverage Manager

• Orchestrating all food points and table service at Nestlé Research, while leading the end-to-end delivery of F&B experiences for daily hospitality, VIP visits, conferences, celebrations, and other internal and external events, from developing creative concepts and proposals to coordinating operational set-ups and ensuring a seamless guest experience.

• Leading, developing, and inspiring a diverse food and beverage team of around 25 employees, including permanent employees, apprentices, interns, and ad-hoc staff.

• Creating innovative food and beverage offerings with a strong focus on local sourcing and trusted supplier partnerships.

• Anticipating emerging food and beverage trends and turning best practices into fresh, elevated services and guest experiences.

• Connecting hospitality and science through rapid prototyping and close collaboration with the Culinary Flagship team, the wider chefs’ network, hospitality schools, and external partners.

• Championing quality control, food safety, hygiene, and cleaning while advancing the sustainability roadmap, reducing food waste and environmental impact, and maintaining service excellence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven food and beverage management expertise, a strong customer-centric mindset, a passion for service, and the confidence to deliver exceptional VIP experiences.

• Leading assertively and approachably, delegating with confidence and empowering an evolving team to take ownership and grow, while remaining ready to step into operations when needed.

• Combining curiosity and an innovative mindset with strong organization to deliver seamlessly.

• Taking ownership of all aspects of catering operations, from budgets and supplier management to local sourcing, quality standards, and the delivery of an outstanding guest experience.

• Communicating fluently in French and English; proficiency in any additional language is an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Digital Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Lead Patent Counsel - Digital & AI
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference.

jobs.title: Corporate Paralegal
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: December 1, 2026

Deadline for applications: September 15, 2026

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Paralegal in the Corporate & Finance Counsel Team at Nestlé, your mission is to support corporate legal housekeeping, governance and compliance for the Group’s Swiss-based legal entities. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with other Legal & Compliance teams, Group Finance & Control, Human Resources, markets worldwide, external advisors and service providers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Paralegal

• Preparing and executing corporate documents for board and shareholder meetings, including agendas, proxies and minutes and supporting applications to the Commercial Register.

• Contributing to the preparation of Nestlé’s Annual General Meeting.

• Coordinating legalization, notarization, apostille, and ownership certification processes with accuracy.

• Maintaining reliable share registers, legal entity data and digital records for reporting, due diligence and compliance.

• Supporting corporate transactions, including incorporations, liquidations and restructurings by preparing documents, monitoring projects and coordinating follow-ups.

• Contributing to Nestlé’s compliance with ongoing listing obligations stemming from the stock exchange regulation.

• Driving continuous improvement, digitalization and standardization of legal processes, templates and knowledge management practices.

What will make you successful

• Bringing legal training or proven experience gained in Switzerland, with strong knowledge of the Swiss legal and corporate environment.

• Collaborating openly and transparently with colleagues within the team, internal business partners and external stakeholders.

• Applying strong project management skills to manage deadlines, coordinate stakeholders and follow through on complex matters.

• Using attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership to ensure data quality, accurate records and confidential handling of information.

• Challenging existing processes with a pragmatic mindset and using digital tools to improve ways of working.

• Communicating fluently in French and English; German is a strong asset.

• Demonstrating courage, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a MROI Insights Expert at Nestlé Global Marketing Analytics , your mission is to turn advanced marketing effectiveness analytics into clear, actionable insights that help markets optimize media, trade and marketing investment. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Marketing Analytics, technology teams, local marketing, media and consumer insight teams, zone leads, global media and finance partners. This is an opportunity to help shape and elevate a growing global function, build marketing effectiveness capabilities across the business, and make an impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a MROI Insights Expert

• Leading the translation of marketing mix modelling, statistics and analytics into simple, compelling insights that shape strategic brand and investment decisions.

• Building clear insight stories, recommendations and business cases that help local teams, zones, SBUs and brand teams improve marketing return on investment.

• Facilitating workshops and presentations with local markets, BEOs, zone marketing teams, Nespresso and global stakeholders to translate insights into action.

• Partnering with the data science team to validate modelling outputs, understand the value behind the analysis and identify opportunities to enhance the capability over time.

• Driving adoption of global marketing effectiveness solutions by partnering with markets, zones and global teams across diverse business contexts.

• Supporting capability development by creating learning content and practical guidance that help business teams use marketing effectiveness insights with confidence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness and marketing mix modelling within an agency, advertiser or global business environment.

• Applying a clear understanding of marketing, media, pricing and promotion models to turn complex analysis into practical business recommendations.

• Using advanced presentation, spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to create insight-led stories for senior stakeholders.

• Showing initiative, autonomy and flexibility in a fast-moving environment, while taking ownership and responsibility for delivering high-quality outcomes.

• Looking for opportunities to improve, contributing new ideas and generating trust through strong collaboration, transparency and teamwork.

How you’ll make an impact as a MROI Insights Expert

• Leading the translation of marketing mix modelling, statistics and analytics into simple, compelling insights that shape strategic brand and investment decisions.

• Building clear insight stories, recommendations and business cases that help local teams, zones, SBUs and brand teams improve marketing return on investment.

• Facilitating workshops and presentations with local markets, BEOs, zone marketing teams, Nespresso and global stakeholders to translate insights into action.

• Partnering with the data science team to validate modelling outputs, understand the value behind the analysis and identify opportunities to enhance the capability over time.

• Driving adoption of global marketing effectiveness solutions by partnering with markets, zones and global teams across diverse business contexts.

• Supporting capability development by creating learning content and practical guidance that help business teams use marketing effectiveness insights with confidence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness and marketing mix modelling within an agency, advertiser or global business environment.

• Applying a clear understanding of marketing, media, pricing and promotion models to turn complex analysis into practical business recommendations.

• Using advanced presentation, spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to create insight-led stories for senior stakeholders.

• Showing initiative, autonomy and flexibility in a fast-moving environment, while taking ownership and responsibility for delivering high-quality outcomes.

• Looking for opportunities to improve, contributing new ideas and generating trust through strong collaboration, transparency and teamwork.

• Communicating fluently and confidently in English, with the ability to present clear insights to senior stakeholders.
